name: gmt-platform
description: GMT Link — plataforma interna de operaciones de GMT (monorepo)

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @gmt-platform/contracts test && pnpm --filter @gmt-platform/backend-central test:unit && pnpm --filter @gmt-platform/web test
